title: Nonlinear SEA Preload Control for Knee Assistance under Limited Runtime Sensing
ko: 제한된 실행 시점 센싱에서 무릎 보조를 위한 비선형 SEA 예압 제어
lead: Jongchan Mun and Sang Rok Jin
source: Pioneer_2022_proposal.pdf: PDF p11/printed p2 and PDF p40/printed p31

stages.caption: Preserve natural movement while preparing active support.
stages.question: Who needs this assistance?
stages.notes: This work concerns an active artificial knee for older adults who need knee replacement and also experience sarcopenia. We begin with the person, follow the biomechanical implant into its nonlinear spring, and then ask how reinforcement learning could control assistance. The motion on the cover is a visual reference, not evidence of an assistance benefit. 한국어: 기존 ICCAS 제목만 유지하고 현재 진행 중인 연구로 구성한다. 표지 보행 연출은 대상 노인에 대한 보조 성능 결과가 아니다. Cover spring: actual stored double-spiral FEA loading frames are replayed forward and backward in the same 1.12-second presentation cycle as recorded walking. The enlarged inset and timing are explanatory presentation choices, not a coupled gait/FEA spring response or a solved unloading branch. PNU signature is the original official transparent PNG, aspect ratio preserved.

title: Background
lead: Aging affects the joint and the muscles that move it.
source: Pioneer_2022_proposal.pdf: PDF p11/printed p2 and PDF p40/printed p31 · Mizner et al.,2005 · MyoAssist open-source models

stages.caption: Joint degeneration can limit everyday movement in older adults.
stages.notes: The Pioneer proposal begins with older adults who need knee replacement because of joint degeneration. Keep the same person visible while approaching the knee. The joint-degeneration comparison is an explanatory illustration, and the generic musculoskeletal model is not an elderly patient-specific reconstruction. Introduce the muscles after explaining what replacement changes. 한국어: 수술을 고려하는 고령층과 관절 손상에서 출발한다. 근감소증은 다음 단계에서 노화의 맥락으로 자연스럽게 연결한다.
stages.body:
Joint degeneration
can limit everyday movement.

The target is an older adult
needing knee replacement.

stages.caption: Replacement changes the joint surfaces. Muscles still produce movement.
stages.question: What happens when muscle strength also declines?
stages.notes: Conventional total knee replacement changes damaged joint surfaces using metal components and a polyethylene insert. The surrounding muscles remain responsible for producing movement. Retain the same knee, its neighbouring bones and the muscle context while inserting the conventional components. The animated separation, five-plane femoral display preparation, tibial preparation, insertion, an insert-surface top view before reduction, and reduction are educational; it is not a validated patient fit. 한국어: 일반 인공관절의 표면 치환 역할을 보여주고, 여전히 움직임을 만드는 근육으로 시선을 이어간다.
stages.body:
Replace the joint surfaces.

The muscles
still produce movement.

stages.caption: Quadriceps strength can drop sharply during early recovery after knee replacement.
stages.question: How could we support weakened muscles?
stages.notes: Mizner et al. studied 20 patients with unilateral knee osteoarthritis, tested on average 10 days before and 27 days after primary total knee arthroplasty. Quadriceps strength decreased by 62% compared with the preoperative value. The audience graph normalizes preoperative strength to 100 and reconstructs the reported postoperative level as 38; these are relative values, not measured torque units, prevalence or fabricated individual data. No error bars are invented. This is a small 2005 study of early postoperative weakness, not a sarcopenia prevalence, long-term deficit, inevitable outcome for every patient or evidence that our device solves it. The Pioneer target still includes older adults with sarcopenia, but postoperative activation failure and muscle atrophy must not be conflated with the sarcopenia diagnosis. Source: https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/15866968/ ; https://doi.org/10.2106/JBJS.D.01992. 한국어: 수술 전 약 10일과 수술 후 평균 27일에 측정한 20명 연구에서 대퇴사두근력이 수술 전보다 62% 감소했다. 수술 전=100, 수술 후=38로 정규화하여 표시한다. 62%는 환자 비율이나 장기적 근감소증 수치가 아니며 초기 수술 후 근력 저하이다. 우리 장치의 보조 효과를 보여주는 결과도 아니다.
stages.body:
Joint replacement does not
immediately restore strength.

Early recovery can involve
substantial muscle weakness.

stages.caption: Assistance can be worn outside the body.
stages.notes: Show three actual open-source MyoAssist human–device models: HMEDI_L1 (hip assistance via cables), OpenExo_L1 (ankle assistance via a strut), and DephyExoBoot_L1 (ankle assistance via a boot). Preserve the source devices, their body attachments and the source human geometry. Canonical standing and source-keyframe motion are kinematic presentation replays, not trained assistance policies or evidence of a walking benefit. The examples illustrate external assistance and attachment locations; their appearance is not evidence of discomfort, clinical effectiveness or comparative superiority. 한국어: MyoAssist에서 실제 사람 모델에 장착된 HMEDI L1, OpenExo L1, Dephy ExoBoot L1을 보여준다. 기본 기립 자세와 원본 키프레임으로 구성한 기구학 재생이며 학습된 보조 보행이나 보조 효과 검증 결과가 아니다. 몸에 고정하여 힘을 전달하는 구조를 설명하고 외골격 전반의 불편함·열등성으로 확대하지 않는다.
stages.body:
Wearable devices
can support movement.

They transmit support through
attachments to the body.

stages.caption: Could the implant also provide active support?
stages.question: What mechanism could make this possible?
stages.notes: Return to exactly the conventional knee-replacement components shown in the surgery step, then bring in the original BLDC motor model beside them. The composition introduces the idea of combining joint replacement and active assistance. Do not reveal the completed Pioneer assembly in this step or imply that the motor attaches directly to the conventional implant as shown. The arrangement is a research concept rather than a surgically or mechanically validated assembly. Carry the motor-to-joint idea into the Hardware chapter, where the actual mechanism and transmission are explained. 한국어: 2단계의 일반 인공관절에 기존 BLDC 모터를 더하는 개념으로 표현한다. 우리 완성품은 아직 공개하지 않고, 그 결합을 실제로 구현하려면 어떤 기구가 필요한지 다음 Hardware 장으로 이어간다.
stages.body:
Combine joint replacement
with a compact motor.

A research concept for
active assistance.

title: Hardware
ko: 무릎의 움직임을 보존하고 구동 기능 더하기
lead: Follow the same implant from its joint mechanism to its motor and gears.
source: Moon, thesis interim presentation, 2024-12-10: slides3–15 · original AAKJ CAD/URDF and restored kinematics · native-knee primary references

stages.caption: The biomechanical joint was the starting point before active assistance.
stages.question: Why is a simple hinge insufficient?
stages.notes: The previous team analyzed knee motion and developed the equivalent four-bar foundation before my contribution. Natural movement involves more than rotation about one stationary hinge. Reference the interim presentation printed page 4 (PPTX slide 6, image22.gif) and the sagittal bone-motion GIF on printed page 3 (PPTX slide 5, image17.gif). Recreate their flexion, roll/glide and medial-side pivot vocabulary in Three.js using actual native bone surfaces. The source kinematic pivot is used only as the explanatory replay timing; this is not recovered cadaveric motion. Compare a qualitative native-knee illustration with the source implant. The source bones are real meshes, while comparison rollback and pivot are authored explanatory motion, not measurements from the hinge-only STS trace. 한국어: 선행 팀의 기여를 명시한다.
stages.body:
The knee rolls and glides
as it bends.

Its motion is more than
a fixed hinge.

stages.caption: An equivalent four-bar lets the joint centre move during flexion.
stages.question: How does that movement create medial rotation?
stages.notes: Track a frame rigidly fixed to the J2–J3 femoral link, with its neutral origin at URDF [0,0,0.021] m. Its trajectory is reference-point dependent; do not call J2 itself the femoral frame. The exact orthographic sagittal view shows the projected path. Follow the four equivalent centres. J1 is the Peek_Bushing cam-follower centre; J2 is the curved-slot circle centre in Condyle_Right, an equivalent point rather than a physical pin. J3 is R3 and J4 is R2. The source cam constraint is represented by an equivalent connection without inventing another physical bar. 한국어: J2 등가점을 실물 핀으로 설명하지 않는다.
stages.body:
An equivalent four-bar
recreates femoral motion.

The aim is to mimic knee motion.

stages.caption: One bend couples Joint 3 descent, slider retreat and medial rotation.
stages.question: How does the same motion look from above?
stages.notes: Keep the source side view while following Joint 3 displacement into the guide and slider. The constrained path provides the connection between flexion and the axial motion examined next. Genuine source components and restored kinematics are retained. 한국어: 측면에서 J3 변위와 실제 슬라이더 구속을 먼저 이해시킨다.
stages.body:
One bend couples
Joint 3 descent,
slider retreat, and
medial-pivot rotation.

stages.caption: The same bend produces rotation around the medial side.
stages.question: Where does active torque enter?
stages.notes: Now turn to the axial view of the same mechanism. Follow the constrained slider motion into medial-pivot rotation. This is restored source kinematics, compared with authored qualitative native motion rather than a patient-specific measured match. The actual Slider_Cover mesh remains traceable. 한국어: 같은 기구를 축방향에서 보며 굴곡과 내측회전의 연동을 설명한다.
stages.body:
The same motion rotates
about the medial side.

Flexion and axial rotation
are mechanically coupled.

stages.caption: The motor and gears add a drive path to the biomechanical mechanism.
stages.question: What if the person moves the joint first?
stages.notes: Reveal the motor and follow the gears toward the elastic element and output. Compact reduction provides useful torque but makes reverse interaction important. The person can initiate movement too, so we must examine the same path from the output back toward the motor. 한국어: 모터·기어 전달과 사람 주도 역방향 상호작용을 같은 단계에서 연결한다.
stages.body:
Motor → gears → joint

Add active drive while keeping
the coupled knee motion.

stages.caption: Motor, series spring and output form one drive path.
stages.question: Why should that element be nonlinear?
stages.notes: Explode the original motor assembly, the two source spring leaves and the output hub without reparenting any source joint. The motor shaft remains owned by the motor assembly; the splined bevel gear is the output-side visual anchor. Presentation-only offsets are removed on exit. Stay in the same implant as the view approaches the original spring location. Series elasticity can separate rigid motor drive from compliant interaction at the output. The next chapter defines the SEA and explains the stiffness trade-off and actual spiral design. Native-knee background references: https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/15330038/ ; https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/11132285/. 한국어: 같은 인공관절 내부의 원본 스프링 위치로 접근하며 다음 SEA 설명을 준비한다.
stages.body:
A series spring connects
the drive to the output.

Compliance is part of
the drive design.

subtitle: Preserve Knee Motion, Then Add a Drive
notes:
Stage 0: The previous team analyzed knee motion and developed the equivalent four-bar foundation before my contribution. Natural movement involves more than rotation about one stationary hinge. Stage 2: Keep the source side view while following Joint 3 displacement into the guide and slider. The constrained path provides the connection between flexion and the axial motion examined next. Genuine source components and restored kinematics are retained. 한국어: 측면에서 J3 변위와 실제 슬라이더 구속을 먼저 이해시킨다.

title: Nonlinear Torsion Spring
lead: A spring in the torque path links mechanical compliance to assistance control.
source: Moon, thesis interim presentation, 2024-12-10: slides3–15 · original spring CAD · separate archived representative FEA

stages.caption: A series elastic actuator places a spring between the motor drive and the load.
stages.question: What should this spring allow?
stages.notes: SEA means series elastic actuator. The spring lies in the torque-transmission path between the motor-side drive and the output. Relative rotation deforms the spring and generates elastic torque. This gives the person a compliant interaction instead of an ideally rigid transmission. 한국어: 처음 듣는 청중을 위해 SEA의 위치와 역할을 먼저 정의한다.
stages.subtitle: Elasticity in the torque path
stages.body:
SEA means
series elastic actuator.

The spring lies in the torque path.

stages.caption: Low stiffness permits yielding, but useful torque can require more deflection.
stages.question: Can one constant stiffness serve both needs?
stages.notes: With a linear spring, low stiffness needs more relative deflection for the same torque, while high stiffness resists motion more strongly. This is a design trade-off rather than proof that every conventional SEA fails. We want yielding behavior at small loading and stronger torque transfer as deformation grows. 한국어: 낮은 강성과 큰 토크 전달 사이의 설계 상충을 설명한다.
stages.subtitle: One stiffness, two competing needs
stages.body:
Soft enough to yield.

Stiff enough to transmit torque
within limited travel.

stages.caption: The design seeks a stiffness that rises as the spring winds.
stages.question: How can geometry change that stiffness?
stages.notes: A nonlinear torque–deflection relationship is the mechanical objective. It changes how much added torque follows an added relative angle. This explains why a nonlinear spring is useful before showing the specific spiral geometry. No performance curve on this conceptual step is an experimental or learned result. 한국어: 목표 곡선의 개념과 검증된 특성곡선을 구분한다.
stages.subtitle: Compliant first, stiffer as winding grows
stages.body:
Let stiffness rise with winding.

Balance yielding with
torque transmission.

stages.caption: Two spiral units in series carry the same torque and share the total deflection.
stages.question: Which unit deforms more first?
stages.notes: In an ideal quasistatic serial pair, both springs transmit the same torque and their deflections add. The compliant unit deforms more initially; the stiffer unit also deforms, rather than waiting with zero torque. The axial source-CAD view exposes strip width and coil spacing; axial depth is a separate dimension. 한국어: 직렬 연결은 같은 토크이며 변위가 합쳐진다는 점을 분명히 한다.
stages.subtitle: Two spring units share one torque
stages.body:
In series: same torque.

Both springs deform;
their deflections add.

stages.caption: Strip width, axial depth and coil gap define the spiral geometry.
stages.question: How can the design be examined through analysis?
stages.notes: Identify strip width a, axial depth b and coil gap as separate dimensions. The native spring does not acquire nonlinearity from an invented variable-width profile. The historical concept uses turn approach and the winding limit to change additional compliance, with more added deflection then shared by the stiffer serial unit. This design illustration is not solved contact or a calibrated native spring law. Axial depth cannot be inferred from a top view alone. 한국어: 폭a·축방향 깊이b·코일 간격을 구분하고 실제 원본에 없는 가변 폭 형상을 주장하지 않는다. 다음 해석은 별도 대표형상이다.
stages.subtitle: Contact changes the free flexure
stages.body:
As the gap closes,
neighboring turns engage.

Less free flexure produces
higher tangent stiffness.

stages.caption: Follow deformation and the torque–rotation response.
stages.question: How does geometry shape the response?
stages.notes: Stress display: normalized by the unchanged global source maximum (4458 MPa); no yield-strength claim or material recalibration is implied. Absolute stress needs a separate model/material/contact/boundary-condition audit. The chart marker is angle-aligned to the separately supplied P2 a0.7 b10 ANSYS curve by piecewise linear interpolation. Its torque is not the reaction torque from the displayed FEA; this is a coordinated presentation, not a paired simulation result. Stored loading frames run forward and in reverse for visual inspection; no unloading solution is implied. The actual FEA is a reconstructed two-arm representative geometry from the NAS, not the complete native compliant/stiff CAD assembly. Actual converged frames use circular inner-node motion and fixed outer attachments. The chosen full-envelope inter-arm contact model is frictionless and elastic. Displacements are shown at true scale. Source: assets/motion/spring-analysis-report.md ; assets/motion/spring-analysis-summary.json. 한국어: 실제 원본 스프링 시각화와 별도 대표 해석 형상을 명확히 분리한다.

subtitle: Why the Series Elastic Element Is Nonlinear
notes:
Stage 0: SEA means series elastic actuator. The spring lies in the torque-transmission path between the motor-side drive and the output. Relative rotation deforms the spring and generates elastic torque. This gives the person a compliant interaction instead of an ideally rigid transmission. 한국어: 처음 듣는 청중을 위해 SEA의 위치와 역할을 먼저 정의한다.

Stage 1: With a linear spring, low stiffness needs more relative deflection for the same torque, while high stiffness resists motion more strongly. This is a design trade-off rather than proof that every conventional SEA fails. We want yielding behavior at small loading and stronger torque transfer as deformation grows. 한국어: 낮은 강성과 큰 토크 전달 사이의 설계 상충을 설명한다.

Stage 2: A nonlinear torque–deflection relationship is the mechanical objective. It changes how much added torque follows an added relative angle. This explains why a nonlinear spring is useful before showing the specific spiral geometry. No performance curve on this conceptual step is an experimental or learned result. 한국어: 목표 곡선의 개념과 검증된 특성곡선을 구분한다.

Stage 3: In an ideal quasistatic serial pair, both springs transmit the same torque and their deflections add. The compliant unit deforms more initially; the stiffer unit also deforms, rather than waiting with zero torque. The axial source-CAD view exposes strip width and coil spacing; axial depth is a separate dimension. 한국어: 직렬 연결은 같은 토크이며 변위가 합쳐진다는 점을 분명히 한다.

Stage 4: Identify strip width a, axial depth b and coil gap as separate dimensions. The native spring does not acquire nonlinearity from an invented variable-width profile. The historical concept uses turn approach and the winding limit to change additional compliance, with more added deflection then shared by the stiffer serial unit. This design illustration is not solved contact or a calibrated native spring law. Axial depth cannot be inferred from a top view alone. 한국어: 폭a·축방향 깊이b·코일 간격을 구분하고 실제 원본에 없는 가변 폭 형상을 주장하지 않는다. 다음 해석은 별도 대표형상이다.

Stage 5: Stress display: normalized by the unchanged global source maximum (4458 MPa); no yield-strength claim or material recalibration is implied. Absolute stress needs a separate model/material/contact/boundary-condition audit. The chart marker is angle-aligned to the separately supplied P2 a0.7 b10 ANSYS curve by piecewise linear interpolation. Its torque is not the reaction torque from the displayed FEA; this is a coordinated presentation, not a paired simulation result. Stored loading frames run forward and in reverse for visual inspection; no unloading solution is implied. The actual FEA is a reconstructed two-arm representative geometry from the NAS, not the complete native compliant/stiff CAD assembly. Actual converged frames use circular inner-node motion and fixed outer attachments. The chosen full-envelope inter-arm contact model is frictionless and elastic. Displacements are shown at true scale. Source: assets/motion/spring-analysis-report.md ; assets/motion/spring-analysis-summary.json. 한국어: 실제 원본 스프링 시각화와 별도 대표 해석 형상을 명확히 분리한다.

Stage 6: Original ANSYS CSV tables from the user-confirmed NAS backup are plotted with every finite torque point. P=2 mm, a=0.7 mm, b=10 mm spans 1.2–120 degrees; b=20 mm spans 0.45–45 degrees. Each panel has its own labelled axes. The original torque decrease is retained. title: Control
lead: Follow the elastic state from the drive into a coupled human–implant simulation.

stages.caption: Control the elastic state, not an ideal knee torque.
stages.question: What should we prepare, and when?
stages.notes: The same spring carries the story forward from mechanical design. Relative rotation between the referred motor angle and the device output angle defines spring deformation; the nonlinear spring law maps deformation to elastic torque. The device output coordinate is not automatically the anatomical knee angle. Preload amount and timing must be coordinated with motion and physical actuator limits. The animated arrows and preparation sequence illustrate this control question; they are not a newly optimized trajectory. 한국어: 모터 환산각과 장치 출력각의 차이로 스프링이 변형된다. 무릎에 이상 토크를 바로 주는 문제가 아니라 탄성 상태를 준비하는 문제로 전환한다.
stages.subtitle: Control the Spring State
stages.body:
Relative angle
sets spring deformation.

Choose how much support
and when to prepare it.

stages.caption: Human muscles and the implant respond together.
stages.question: How should assistance follow the movement?
stages.notes: The current sit-to-stand simulation uses MuJoCo-Warp with the actual bilateral device and the 22-muscle human model. Muscle control and implant motor control are separate pathways coupled through movement and contact. This is the model behind the preliminary result, not the MyoLeg80 illustration used for background. A frozen learned human controller and engineering muscle-output limiter remain in the evaluated setup; it is not a calibrated sarcopenic older-adult model or clinical validation. Show the real chair and body geometry and preserve source bone/device transforms. 한국어: 인체 근육 경로와 장치 모터 경로를 구분한다. 현재 성능 자료는 22근육 공학 모델이며 노인 대상 검증을 뜻하지 않는다.
stages.subtitle: Evaluate Human–Implant Interaction
stages.body:
The person and implant
respond together.

Separate muscle control
from motor control.

stages.caption: Prepare, assist and release through one movement.
stages.question: Can a working strategy be built with full simulation state?
stages.notes: Use one continuous seated-to-standing movement to introduce preparation, assistance and release. These labels explain the intended sequencing; display any target illustration separately from measured replay channels. The spring target must pass through the observer, the existing motor servo and the same physical drive limits. Avoid implying that the learned student independently discovered an optimal preload schedule or that the cyclic illustration proves net energy recovery. 한국어: 앉은 자세에서 준비하고 일어설 때 보조하며 이후 탄성 상태를 조절하는 하나의 흐름을 보여준다. 설명용 목표와 실제 기록을 구분하고 에너지 절감으로 해석하지 않는다.
stages.subtitle: Prepare, Assist, Release
stages.body:
Prepare the elastic state.

Assist the rise.
Release as the task changes.

stages.caption: Develop a full-state teacher before reducing the sensing.
stages.question: Which information is available on the device?
stages.notes: The teacher in this work is an explicit model-based assistance controller with finite searches over preparation and release proposals. It can inspect privileged simulator information while developing a working strategy. The separately frozen human controller drives muscles; the implant teacher is not that muscle policy. The teacher provides trajectories and target corrections for imitation, rather than proof of globally optimal or clinically beneficial assistance. Keep task execution and hardware limits visible as design conditions. 한국어: 티처는 전체 상태를 활용하는 명시적 모델 기반 보조 제어와 유한 탐색으로 구성했다. 인체를 움직이는 학습 정책과 장치 티처를 혼동하지 않는다.
stages.subtitle: Develop a Full-State Teacher
stages.body:
Use full simulation state
to develop a working strategy.

Keep task conditions
and actuator limits.

stages.caption: Estimate the spring state from device-side signals.
stages.question: Can a student retain the strategy with this information?
stages.notes: The permitted actor input is Device54: 18 features at each of three successive frames. One frame contains bilateral local-cue phase one-hot features (8), sine and cosine of motor encoder angles (4), encoder velocities (2), applied motor torque as an ideal current-to-torque proxy (2), and previous motor requests (2). The declared local cue clock is part of this experiment; it is not an autonomous estimate of human intent. No true output angle, muscle activation or hidden human state is supplied to the student actor. A physics-based encoder/current spring observer runs at 100 Hz. The current proxy, friction and sensing assumptions still require hardware validation. 한국어: 엔코더·전류 대응값뿐 아니라 이전 명령과 알려진 로컬 큐가 포함된다. 18×3=54이며 실제 센서만으로 자율 의도 추정을 완성했다는 주장은 하지 않는다.
stages.subtitle: Operate with Device-Side Sensing
stages.body:
Use device-side signals
and a declared local cue.

Infer the spring state
with a physics observer.

stages.caption: Imitate the teacher, then execute through the physical drive.
stages.question: What can the current implementation demonstrate?
stages.notes: The selected student is a behavior-cloned recurrent GRU model trained for 400 epochs, using the 54-value device history and its own memory. It updates two mirrored desired-spring-torque residuals at 10 Hz. Those residuals modify an explicit goal controller; a physics observer and fixed servo convert the spring target into motor requests at 100 Hz. It does not directly command unlimited anatomical knee torque. A subsequent recurrent PPO pilot completed three updates, but selected best_iteration=0: the initial imitation model remained best under that pilot criterion. No additional PPO benefit or neural performance advantage is claimed. 한국어: 최종 채택 모델은 모방학습 학생이다. GRU가 양측 스프링 목표 토크를 보정하며 하위 물리 관측기와 고정 서보를 통과한다. PPO는 추가 개선이 확인되지 않아 성과 도표에서 제외한다.
stages.subtitle: Transfer the Strategy to a Student
stages.body:
Imitation learning
transfers the strategy.

A recurrent student adjusts
spring-torque targets.

stages.caption: A preliminary simulation completes the nominal sit-to-stand task.
stages.question: What changes when assistance must repeat during walking?
stages.notes: Replay the selected student condition from the actual 18-second record: seated on a 40 cm chair, rising, and maintaining quiet standing for about 13.21 seconds by the independent diagnostic criterion. The audit includes 96 total worlds across three controller conditions; the student condition contributes 32 nominal numerical copies with noise=0, not 32 distinct starts, patients or robustness trials. All recorded hardware gates pass, but the audit explicitly remains diagnostic_only=true and qualified=false. Substep equality-map freshness, native closed-loop residuals and device–chair collision clearance still require separate audits. If effort is asked about: the whole-record activation-squared integral is about 3.273% lower than powered position hold, while the zero-neural-residual controller is about 3.324% lower under the same final audit. This does not show a student or GRU advantage. Do not put those percentages or a 32/32 success-rate headline on screen. 한국어: 성과는 명목 조건에서 작동하는 예비 기립 데모 수준으로 제시한다. 동일 초기조건 복제이며 강건성·보조 효과 검증 완료로 표현하지 않는다.
stages.subtitle: Preliminary Sit-to-Stand Evaluation
stages.body:
Rise and maintain standing
in the nominal simulation.

Preliminary execution;
model audits remain.

stages.caption: Repeated walking requires the next spring state to be prepared in time.
stages.question: How can anticipation remain within the actuator limits?
stages.notes: Use the latest independent walking record as a challenge illustration, not a successful assistance comparison. The candidate terminated at 27.19 seconds with device-side shaft power 26.9548206 W exceeding the 25 W bound. This is a different walking controller and experiment from the sit-to-stand student. At the limiting instant, the motor-generated power was already saturated at 25 W; motor-side inertia accounts for the larger shaft power. Requesting more motor torque at that instant is therefore insufficient. Small cycle-to-cycle differences in nonlinear spring state motivate earlier preparation. Assistance and position-hold walking speeds differed beyond the comparison tolerance, so reported activation differences do not establish effort reduction. 한국어: 실패 수치는 하드웨어가 불가능함을 뜻하지 않고 현재 보정 표현의 한계다. 같은 인체 장면으로 이어가되 기립 학생과 별도 보행 실험임을 노트와 작은 조건 문구로 분명히 한다.
stages.subtitle: Toward Continuous Walking Assistance
stages.body:
Walking repeats the challenge
every cycle.

Prepare the next spring state
within actuator limits.

title: Conclusion
lead: A biomechanical implant, nonlinear spring and limited-sensing control form one research path.
source: Current design and preliminary simulation status · docs/control-evidence.md

stages.caption: Preserve joint motion, shape compliance and prepare support.
stages.question: What must be verified before useful assistance is established?
stages.notes: Return to the same human–implant scene and connect the four contributions without introducing a new performance claim: the biomechanical mechanism preserves coupled knee motion; the motor adds an active path; nonlinear series elasticity shapes interaction; the observer and imitation student provide a limited-sensing execution route. The present result is nominal sit-to-stand execution in a coupled simulation. It is not evidence of an elderly patient benefit, a learning advantage or completed physical validation. 한국어: 하드웨어→비선형 스프링→제어의 이유를 하나로 회수한다. 학생 구현을 계획 단계라고 되돌리지 않는다.
stages.body:
Natural motion.

Timely assistance.

One connected research path.

stages.caption: Next: reproducible assistance under the target conditions.
stages.question: Thank you.
stages.notes: The next work is to close the coupling and contact audits, calibrate the spring and device-side sensing, test varied initial conditions and disturbances, and compare valid matched tasks before claiming useful assistance.
